body:
I planned going camping with my wife and dogs. It is quite a beautiful Sunday and I feel curious about the Metocin that Im storing in my freezer. From several reports out there, It seems to be a clear headed psychedelic, and without knowing much what that meant I decided to measure 13 mg to take with me.
My wife does not like seeing me under the influence of psychedelics and I get it; she is sober and Im somewhere between a philosophical drunk and an autistic kid, so I always indulge when Im by myself. Based on reported experiences of being able to perform in social situations, I felt adventurous and wanted to see how the situation would play out.
T 0:00
Its 5 pm, 2 hours before sunset. I decide it is the perfect time and swallow the light brown powder. It looks like chocolate milk powder and tastes slightly bitter. Very easy to down with water. Its a sunny day with clear blue skies. Im inside a dense forest next to a lake with breathtaking views. I do not know what to expect.
T+ 0:25
Is something happening? I feel slight alarms. Im waiting for my wife to come back from the store and I dont know how well in the head she will find me. From the nature of the onset feelings, this seems to be a light dose. I dont want to be very intoxicated, so its ok.
T+ 0: 45
Introspection is definitely heightened. The come-up body load is very easy to handle. It is there, but it does not bother me. I feel intoxicated but capable of setting up my campground. Colors and textures are becoming psychedelic. My wife is back and Im talking to her as we organize. She knows Im on Metocin and she has no idea what to expect of me either.   We just go about our things. Im enjoying the views.
T+ 1:20
Im surprised. This feels different for me. The visuals are quite strong; they are soft and creamy. Colors are surreal and strange visualizations of my mind present to me in the most beautiful ways. Im enjoying the sunset with my wife. We are talking, laughing, playing with the dogs. I just want to sit down and relax even though Im feeling euphoric. It is a good experience.
I just want to sit down and relax even though Im feeling euphoric. It is a good experience.
T+ 2:30
The sun is hiding behind the horizon leaving us with left over light on our surroundings. I cant stop being amazed by this substance. I can keep long trains of thoughts and I feel I can come across funny and well grounded. Full logical sentences can come out of me during the conversations with my wife. As I talk to her I keep a straight face but Im seeing much more that she can even imagine.
T + 3:30
I feel very clear headed and the crazy visuals have diminished. I feel weird about saying clear headed, because I dont know how else to describe it. There is definitely a headspace. It is not as therapeutic and life changing as other psychedelics Ive tried. But it is nice. It keeps me positive and in a good mood. I burned my finger picking up a burning stick. It would have normally ruined the night. But I can make myself ignore the pain and feel there are more importance things to focus on at the moment. Im still having a good time.
T+ 5:30
There is nice afterglow that I can still appreciate thanks to the reflected light form the bonfire. I feel tired and I want to call it a night. I go for a short walk with my dogs hoping to find a snake or an owl before I end the day. The body load has been very forgiving; it does feel sedating, but it does not impede a nice walk.
T+ 16:00
It was a cold night, but I felt very tolerant to it. I wonder if it has to do with the Metocin. Pain or cold could not bother me much. I wake up with good energy ready to take on a new day. I smile. It was a good evening with this novel(for me) substance known as 4-Aco-MET.
Conclusion:
I use psychedelics mostly for therapeutic reasons. After tripping for a while its hard for me to be amazed at the visuals every time. However, I will keep a place for this substance. It did not impair my brain at the dosage that I took, and I think this gives it very good props. I was eloquent, introspective, mildly euphoric, and able to perform tasks such as tent building, grilling meat, and keeping a conversation.  It worries me a bit that people might experience muscle spasms as Ive read, but my personal experience was very easy on the body. I dont know about frequent use, but sporadic use on the lower dosage side sounds like a good deal. Im happy I discovered the potential of the Metocin.
